GAME RULES:
1. Kuhn poker is a two-player card game. The deck includes only three cards: King (K) > Queen (Q) > Jack (J).

    a. <PASS>: place no additional chips into the pot.

Always choose only one action from the legal actions and output `<answer>{your chosen action}</answer>` with no extra text after you finish the thinking process.
